description: Piece gates for the map repo named by CITY_WALKS_REPO. Tripwires on the common paths, not containment: a command or edit that names a sprite needs a recent object record; a reply that calls a piece fixed needs review evidence bound to the sprite on disk. Silent outside that repo, and everywhere when CITY_WALKS_REPO is unset. Limits are listed at the top of piece_gate.py. site_guard.py blocks a `wrangler pages deploy` from the wrong branch, or of a build made for another site.
